status: art-direction pilot; owner approval required before integration

fit.rule: measure final wrapped text first; fit the selected contour tightly around that block
forbidden: shrinking text to make an oversized body appear intentional

composition.rule: boolean-union body, tail, and any bridges first; draw one final outside contour
composition.speakerTail: two tapering outside edges; completely open at balloon junction; no base seam
composition.bridge: exactly two narrow side rails; completely open into both balloons; no end caps or balloon-outline seams

bridgeWidthLineHeight.comparison: visibly slimmer than an ordinary speaker-tail base

forbidden: stroking body and tail as separate closed polygons
balloon outline crossing a tail opening
bridge with only one visible side rail

bodies.use: ordinary speech; slightly warmer or more animated
shouting, alarm, or explosive anger only
phone, radio, or speaker transmission only
fear, injury, exhaustion, or fading speech
traditional thought only; captions remain the default internal voice

components.use: open vertical link between separated balloons
open horizontal link between separated balloons
